name: tasks_list
description: List tasks with bounded lifecycle filtering. (GET /services/data/v1/tasks) Declared lifecycle: tasks.status: open → in_progress → blocked → (completed | cancelled). Use this to resolve a human name, title, external code, or other business handle to the exact tasks primary key required by item tools.
